cases.name: conditional-ref-selects-storage
cases.body:
var a=1
var b=2
let u=U.R
let p=match u {L=>&mut a,R=>&mut b}
*p=7
return a*10+b
cases.cs: int a=1,b=2; bool right=true; ref int p=ref (right?ref b:ref a); p=7; return a*10+b;

if(*p==*q){return 1}
return 0
